title: GIANT GEM(Beta)
bodyHtml:
The current GIANT GEM is a beta version. (Last update: Mar 30, 2022)

  • Please clean the cache of the browser if GIANT GEM isn't functioning correctly.
  • Setting a genomic region: either enter a region in the format 'chromosome_number:start_coordinate-end_coordinate' (e.g., 8:117912512-118238953) or enter a gene name to set the region to the coordinates of that gene.
  • To change or add search, choose another sets of search parameters, and then make a selection from the "Compare data" menu:
    • 'New search' removes the data on the page and initiates a new search.
    • 'Only overlapping' displays association plots for each phenotype and a "Combined" plot showing variants that are significantly associated with all added phenotypes. Only the shared variants are added to the table below.
    • 'All' displays association plots for each phenotype and a plot with all variants that are associated with all added phenotypes. All variants are added to the table below.
    • Association can be compared by phenotype, sex and ancestries.
  • To filter the variants by their overlap with tissue-specific epigenomic annotations, click "Filter associated variants by tissues and annotations", then select a tissue category and a type of epigenomic annotation. The variant table is filtered to display only those variants located within annotations of the selected type in the selected tissue.
  • To star variants, click a star icon on the table, or open information popup on the region plot by clicking a dot and click star icon.
  • Available sex per phenotype:
    • BMI_GIANT: Mixed
    • HEIGHT_GIANT: Mixed
    • WHRadjBMI_GIANT: Male, Female, Mixed
    • WHRU_GIANT: Male, Female, Mixed
  • Learn more about the data used to filter associated variants by gene-links at CMDGA
